about.title: ‏About‏
about.resetCacheHint: ‏Clears this app's saved files and the background service worker on this device, then reloads. Use it if the app looks out of date or misbehaves. Your settings, downloaded modules and notes are kept.‏
about.description: ‏A modern, open-source Bible study application designed for in-depth Scripture reading and research.‏

measures.title: ‏Weights and measures‏
measures.enabled.description: ‏Mark ancient units in the text and show their modern equivalents.‏
measures.display.description: ‏Off keeps the text clean (the conversions are in the Study panel). Otherwise: a dotted underline with a popup, or an underline with the conversion in [brackets] after the phrase.‏
measures.showInReading.description: ‏Reading mode stays clean text unless you turn this on.‏
measures.secondary.description: ‏Also show the value in another system (imperial: length and weight only).‏
measures.money.description: ‏Days' wages (default), the weight of metal, or both.‏
measures.dailyWage.description: ‏Optional: shows a modern estimate of a sum from days' wages. 0 = off.‏
measures.wageCurrency.description: ‏A currency code such as USD, EUR or GBP.‏
measures.ranges.description: ‏Show the uncertainty range of a value: when it is wide (auto), always, or never.‏

web.depthHint: ‏How far from the centre verse to look. 1 shows the verses it references directly, 2 adds the verses those reference, and 3 goes one step further.‏
web.minStrengthHint: ‏Hides weaker links. Strength (1 to 5) is how closely two verses are tied: the Treasury of Scripture Knowledge lists the most direct references first for each phrase, and links that run both ways or appear in more than one source score higher. 1 shows every link, 5 only the strongest.‏

arcs.title: ‏Cross-references across the Bible‏
arcs.canvasLabel: ‏Chapter arcs. Left and Right choose a chapter, Page Up and Page Down jump a book, Enter opens it, Escape clears.‏
arcs.hint: ‏Choose a chapter to see what it connects to.‏
arcs.minWeightHint: ‏Hides chapter pairs joined by only a few or weak links. A pair's strength adds up the strength of every cross-reference between the two chapters, so raising the slider keeps only the most heavily linked pairs.‏

compass.depthHint: ‏How far from the centre verse to look. 1 shows the verses it references directly, 2 adds the verses those reference, and 3 goes one step further.‏
compass.minStrengthHint: ‏Hides weaker links. Strength (1 to 5) is how closely two verses are tied: the Treasury of Scripture Knowledge lists the most direct references first for each phrase, and links that run both ways or appear in more than one source score higher. 1 shows every link, 5 only the strongest.‏
compass.hint: ‏Each star sits in the direction of its place in the Bible: Genesis at the top, running clockwise to Revelation. The rings show how many hops a verse is from the centre.‏
